The '''Place of Enlightenment Through Knowledge''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Romossobar]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tarben Jenoquan]] was studying there when he was briefly infected with the [[Dark Plague]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=message|Casualty List|Master Jaric Kaedan}}</ref>
